subject: Price adjustment notice - effective January 1, 2027
text:
Dear Valued Customer,

Due to continued increases in steel wire rod and zinc plating costs, Acme Fasteners will implement a price adjustment of 6.5 percent on carbon steel fasteners and 4 percent on stainless products, effective for orders placed on or after January 1, 2027.

Orders placed before that date will be honored at current pricing, including blanket orders with releases scheduled through March 31, 2027.

Your account manager will reach out with an updated price sheet. We appreciate your understanding and continued partnership.

Sincerely,
Acme Fasteners Sales Team
label: ordinary
note: Price-change notice with formal 'effective date' wording similar to bank-change letters.
